content:
amanda_sales: Quick sync — NovusHealth POC asked for HSM-backed KMS, signed MSA with a few redlines, and Net30 billing. Can legal + procurement confirm routing and if we can accept the DPA subproc changes? They need execution this week to start the POC.
leo_legal: Can you paste the redlines? high level: liability cap? indemnity? data residency? If they remove the liability cap for privacy claims we need exec review.
janet_procurement: Also need clarity on billing flow — is this hosted metered or dedicated reserved for the POC? PO vs invoice matters for procurement team and payment terms.
mike_se: From infra side: private deployment + HSM means we'll need attestation and a KMS endpoint. We support AWS KMS and customer HSM attestation via our onboarding flow. If they're on-prem HSM, we need certs + rotation plan.
amanda_sales: Paste redline snippets from the customer below:
```
MSA Section 4.2: Liability cap changed to $1,000,000 (customer proposes)
DPA Section 2.1: customer requires explicit subprocessor list and prior written consent
SLA: 99.5% uptime target; credits capped at 10% of fees
Signature: requests DocuSign with two signers (Legal + Procurement)
Billing: Net30, invoice to AP@novushealth.com
```
leo_legal: Thanks. We can generally accept a $1M cap for a POC but need to preserve carveouts for IP and will push back on unlimited privacy liability. Subprocessor ask: we can provide a standard list and a 30-day notice for additions. SLA credit language — need to check with product on feasible credit caps.
janet_procurement: For PO routing: they want the PO to reference the order form ID and SOW. If this is Dedicated capacity for POC, we need a monthly commitment line on the order form so finance can issue a PO. If hosted, we'll invoice monthly based on usage; still can accept Net30.
claudia_pm: Timeline note — engineering needs signed order form + PO + network/ASN whitelist. Typical lead time is 72 hours after signature to spin up POC environment. Also request NovusHealth complete our security questionnaire and share SOC2 report.
integration-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3 (status: draft) — envelope will be sent once legal confirms countersign path.
amanda_sales: @leo_legal can you confirm whether we accept the DPA subproc change with our standard notice? @mike_se can you prepare a short KMS attestation note for DocuSign attachment? @janet_procurement please prepare a PO template mapping to orderform ID.
leo_legal: I'll review redlines EOD. If customer insists on removing the liability cap for privacy claims, I'll need a brief for execs. Otherwise we'll propose the standard counter: $1M cap with explicit privacy carveout language.
mike_se: KMS attestation draft — will attach to envelope. Example config snippet we plan to include for reference:
```
kms_provider: "aws"
kms_key_arn: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01-2345"
hsm_attestation: true
key_rotation_policy: "90d"
```
janet_procurement: Got it, will draft PO template and include invoice contact AP@novushealth.com. Also want to confirm billing contact at Novus for POC — Amanda can you confirm?
amanda_sales: Confirming billing contact is elena.tucker@novushealth.com. Next steps I have: 1) @leo_legal finalize counter by EOD, 2) @mike_se attach KMS attestation to DocuSign, 3) @janet_procurement prepare PO template, 4) @claudia_pm block 72 hours after signature for setup. If all green I'll kick the envelope after legal OKs. :sparkles:
leo_legal: Quick flag — if they demand DOCSIS-level escrow or source access, immediate no and escalate to product. Otherwise proceed. :thinking_face:
janet_procurement: thumbs up — I'll queue the PO once orderform ID is finalized. :thumbsup:
amanda_sales: Thanks everyone — will update NovusHealth and await legal counter. Closing notes: keep thread for signatures and attach final envelope link when sent.
